findings.summary: Still blocking `pnpm test:e2e` and harness RG-smoke. Reproduced this round: `pnpm exec playwright test --project=fresh-db` exits 1. firstRun.spec.ts:93 expects [data-aioson-id=home-owner] after skipping the tour and reloading, but step 1 of the part-2 tour opens /empresa/:id/relatorios and skipping keeps that page (prototype .aioson/briefings/relatorios-e-acompanhamento/prototype.html L1321-1322: startTour goes to the step 1 route, endTour does not navigate). The spec is also stale in two more places, both reached only after line 93. Line 99 expects '#/inicio' after the '?', but step 1 opens the company reports page. Lines 103-111 expect a 4-step consultancy tour on the first visit, but PRD AC-ra-37 (prd L314) defines one 5-step tour for both modes, shown once; tourSeenVersion 2 is already saved by then, so no tour opens. No PRD-compliant change to src/features/home/OnboardingTour.tsx can satisfy these assertions. Making them pass by editing package.json `test:e2e`, the e2e fixtures or playwright.config.ts (not writable) would only hide the stale spec, so I did none of these. The engine cannot route this path: it appears in no unit's files. Verified fix, not applied because the file is not in the write paths. In tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts: (1) in the owner tour test, after completeDiagnosis, add `const reportsPage = new RegExp(`#/empresa/${company.id}/relatorios$`);` and after the '1 de 5' check add `await expect(page).toHaveURL(reportsPage);`. (2) After the tourSeen poll, insert `await expect(page).toHaveURL(reportsPage); await openRoute(page, "/inicio");` before `await page.reload();` (the comment becomes 'Skipping counts as seen and keeps the page of the step: the home does not show it again'). (3) Replace the '#/inicio' toHaveURL after tour-reopen with `await expect(page).toHaveURL(reportsPage);`. (4) Rename the consultancy test to "the consultancy mode does not show the tour again and its '?' walks the same 5 steps". After the home-consultant check, assert tour-card has count 0, click [data-aioson-id=tour-reopen], call walkTour(page, 5), then `await openRoute(page, "/inicio")` before the existing reload and checks. A scratch copy with exactly these edits, run with a fresh-db-only scratch config, passes 5/5 (exit 0, 17.3 s). The unified diff is r1-proposal/firstRun.spec.ts.patch in the run log folder. AC-ra-37 is also covered and passing in tests/e2e/home.spec.ts.

In the previous attempt, one install was run against a run-scoped temp database. The preview was not touched; `pnpm dev` applies the 4 new migrations on its next start.
